input: بلی وربّی.

input: الله اکبر.

input: هذا البحر قد ذخرا

input: فاخلع ثیابک و اغرق فیه

output: Likewise, He Whom God shall make manifest abideth in that city until such time as God will have established Him upon the seat of His sovereignty.

output: We have chosen here to be brief in our elucidation of the meanings of Jábulqá, but if thou be of them that truly believe, thou shalt indeed comprehend all the true meanings of the mysteries enshrined within these Tablets.

input: بل انّه خالق الاسم و مبدعه لنفسه لو انتم بطرف الله تنظرون.
output: Nay, He it is Who fashioned that name and created it for Himself, were ye to observe with the eye of God.
